[data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 header { box-shadow: rgba(157, 157, 157, 0.063) 0px 2px 30px; z-index: 999; }
@media print { [data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 header { display: none; } }
[data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 .navbar-brand button { padding-block: 0px; padding-inline: 10px 30px; line-height: 0; color: rgb(39, 43, 65); }
@media only screen and (max-width: 875px) { [data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 .navbar-brand button { padding-block: 0px; padding-inline: 25px 10px; } }
@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) { [data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 .navbar-brand button { padding-block: 0px; padding-inline: 0px 15px; } }
[data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 .mobile-action { position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 20px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); display: inline-flex; -webkit-box-align: center; align-items: center; }
@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) { [data-pf-shell] .pf-div--v2 .mobile-action { inset-inline-end: 0px; } }
